title: La Gran Carta d'Italia (1845)
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: This volume brings together the proceedings of the symposium dedicated to Gran Carta d'Italia, published by Giuseppe Civelli in 1845, organised by the Istituto Lombardo Accademia di Scienze e Lettere with the aim of promoting and making one of its most significant assets fully accessible. Taken as the primary focus of investigation, Gran Carta d'Italia proves to be a point of convergence for a multitude of fields of knowledge and perspectives: historical, geographical, cartographic, archival, scientific and technical. Bucking the trend of a contemporary world prone to simplification and snap judgements, the volume champions the value of complexity, proposing an interdisciplinary approach that weaves together contributions from scholars across different fields. The result is a rich and multifaceted picture, demonstrating how a single document can serve as a crossroads between past and present, between the humanities and the sciences, offering new interpretative frameworks and tools for the management and understanding of the region’s cultural heritage.
